title: Array Constraints
description: Write SystemVerilog code using constraint: array size < 10 and array contents sum = 100. Create a class with random array and these constraints.
hint: Use: rand int array[]; constraint c_size { array.size() < 10; } constraint c_sum { array.sum() == 100; }

title: Simple Assert Statement
description: Write a SystemVerilog module with a simple assert statement to check if a signal is never X during valid cycles.
hint: Use: assert property (@(posedge clk) valid |-> !$isunknown(data)) else $error("Unknown data when valid");

title: Basic Cover Example
description: Create a simple covergroup to track values of a counter. Show understanding of coverpoints and bins.
hint: covergroup cg; coverpoint count { bins low[] = {[0:3]}; bins high[] = {[4:7]}; } endgroup
